notes:
v4.6.55 — Fix: IBKR bots couldn't price stocks (no market-data subscription)

🐛 FIXED — 'could not price …' / Error 10089 blocked every IBKR buy
• IBKR paper accounts don't include a LIVE US-stock market-data subscription, so the bots' price lookups were rejected (Error 10089) and orders failed with 'could not price <ticker>'.
• APEX now requests IBKR's free DELAYED market data (~15-min) when no live subscription exists, and reads the delayed quote fields. That's enough to size orders — fills still execute at the live market.
• Verified on the cloud: the DAY bot priced and placed a real bracket (SNOW, ~$14.8k) on its IBKR slice; LONG prices its candidates with no errors.

If you later add a live IBKR market-data subscription, the bots automatically use it.

Update via the in-app banner.
